entities.name: Miguel Urbán Crespo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel Urbán Crespo is a Spanish activist and politician. A longstanding figure of the Trotskyist Izquierda Anticapitalista platform and co-founder of Podemos, he served as Member of the European Parliament from 2015 to 2024, integrated within the European United Left–Nordic Green Left political group.
